name: Ann "Nancy" Brashears (Ball)
locations: Brashear's Meadow, Prince George's County, Maryland
sources: Find a Grave, memorial 35458870 (Moses Ball Jr., 1748–1831, Ball Cemetery, Hawkins County)
Bonnie Ball, "The Balls of Fairfax and Stafford in Virginia" (1961)
Charles Brashear, "A Brashear(s) Family History", vol. 2 (1999), as reproduced in Ed Simons's deck
Ed Simons, "Simons Family Trees and Genealogy" (slide deck, Sep 2026), pp. 41–52

George Harrison Sanford King Papers (Fredericksburg; FamilySearch, "Stafford, Virginia, Genealogies 1914–1985"), "Miscellaneous Notes, John Ball Family", with King's 1962 certified copy of the will of John Ball from the Clerk's transcript (Stafford Will Book K, p. 35, now lost); images 3:1:33SQ-GPXC-XX4, X8N, XZB, X88 and 3:1:33S7-9PXC-66T
notes: Wife of Moses Ball Sr. and mother of Moses Ball Jr., as Find a Grave and Bonnie Ball's genealogy give her; her surname is also spelled Brashers.

Born 26 Sep 1729 at Brashear's Meadow, Prince George's County, Maryland, daughter of Robert Brashear and Charity Dowell; died 30 Nov 1816 and probably buried in an unmarked grave beside Moses Ball at Arlington (Charles Brashear, A Brashear(s) Family History, vol. 2, 1999; UNPROVEN here, from that compilation).
Married Moses Ball on 27 Jun 1745 (his Bible, as cited by Bonnie Ball and noted by G. H. S. King).
